name: 所有女生会员服务中心
description_zh: 为李佳琦直播间会员提供精选好物试用、畅购服务，支持自然语言下单、导购式选品、商品搜索、规格选择、智能推荐的一站式购物体验。
description_en: It offers Li Jiaqi’s livestream channel members a one-stop shopping experience featuring trials of curated products and seamless purchasing services, supporting natural language ordering, guided product selection, product search, specification selection, and intelligent recommendations.
